---
title: "Descriptives and international case definitions"
output: html_document
---

Reproduces the parts of **Table 3**, **Table S2** and **Table S3** that come from the
analytic datasets, **Figure S1**, **Table 4** (international case definitions, patients
aged 14 and over) and **Table S4** (children under 14 in South Sudan).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
source(here("R", "data.R"))
source(here("R", "metrics.R"))

ssd <- load_ssd(binary = TRUE)
ssd_children <- load_ssd(children = TRUE, binary = TRUE)
bd <- load_bd(binary = TRUE)
```

## Table 3: patient characteristics

IgG, jaundice signs (yellow skin/eyes, dark urine, pale stools), hospitalisation and
death are not in the analytic datasets, so those rows cannot be reproduced here.

```{r table3}
n_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%d (%.0f)", sum(x), 100 * mean(x))
med_iqr <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))

#' @param age_breaks named lower bounds of the age bands (in years)
describe <- function(dat, female, age, days, symptoms,
                     age_breaks = c(`14-19` = 14, `20-39` = 20, `40-59` = 40, `60+` = 60)) {
  groups <- list(Overall = dat,
                 `IgM negative` = dat[dat$infect_bin == 0, ],
                 `IgM positive` = dat[dat$infect_bin == 1, ])
  rows <- function(d) {
    band <- cut(d[[age]], c(age_breaks, Inf), labels = names(age_breaks), right = FALSE)
    delay <- cut(d[[days]], c(-Inf, 7, 14, Inf),
                 labels = c("<1 week", ">1 week to 2 weeks", ">2 weeks to 1 month"))
    c(N = nrow(d),
      Female = n_pct(female(d)),
      `Age, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(d[[age]]),
      sapply(levels(band), function(b) n_pct(band == b)),
      `Days since jaundice onset, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(d[[days]]),
      sapply(levels(delay), function(b) n_pct(delay == b)),
      sapply(symptoms, function(s) n_pct(d[[s]] == 1)))
  }
  as.data.frame(sapply(groups, rows))
}

describe(ssd, function(d) d$id_sex == "Female", "age", "days_since_ajs_baseline", SSD_SYMPTOMS)
describe(bd, function(d) d$sex == "2", "age", "days_since_ajs", BD_SYMPTOMS)
```

## Table S3: children under 14 (South Sudan)

```{r tableS3}
describe(ssd_children, function(d) d$id_sex == "Female", "age", "days_since_ajs_baseline",
         SSD_SYMPTOMS, age_breaks = c(`0-4` = 0, `5-10` = 5, `11-13` = 11))
```

## Table S2: symptoms by delay between jaundice onset and visit

The hospitalised South Sudan subset (SSD\*) is not in the analytic dataset.

```{r tableS2}
delay_band <- function(days) cut(days, c(-Inf, 7, 14, Inf),
                                 labels = c("<1 week", ">1 to 2 weeks", ">2 weeks to 1 month"))
shared <- c(Fever = "fever_ever", `Loss of appetite` = "appetite_ever", Nausea = "nausea_ever",
            Diarrhea = "diarrhea_ever", Vomiting = "vomit_ever", Headache = "head_ever",
            `Abdominal pain` = "abdomen_ever", `Altered mental state` = "mental_ever",
            `Fatigue/drowsiness` = "drowsy_ever", Convulsion = "convulsion_ever")
ssd_names <- c(SSD_TO_JOINT, convulsion_ever = "convulsion")   # BD name -> SSD name
pct_by_delay <- function(dat, days, cols) {
  band <- delay_band(dat[[days]])
  t(sapply(cols, function(s) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * tapply(dat[[s]], band, mean))))
}
ssd_tab <- pct_by_delay(ssd, "days_since_ajs_baseline", setNames(ssd_names[shared], names(shared)))
bd_tab <- pct_by_delay(bd, "days_since_ajs", shared)
colnames(ssd_tab) <- paste("SSD", levels(delay_band(0)))
colnames(bd_tab) <- paste("BD", levels(delay_band(0)))
cbind(ssd_tab, bd_tab)[, c(1, 4, 2, 5, 3, 6)]
```

## Figure S1: days from jaundice onset to visit

```{r figS1, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
library(ggplot2)
bind_rows(
  tibble(country = "South Sudan", days = ssd$days_since_ajs_baseline),
  tibble(country = "Bangladesh", days = bd$days_since_ajs)
) %>%
  count(country, days) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(days, levels = 0:30), n, fill = country)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Bangladesh = "orange", `South Sudan` = "red")) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Days since AJS onset", y = "Number of cases", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Table 4: international case definitions (aged 14 and over)

Acute jaundice alone is met by everyone (sensitivity 100%, specificity 0%).
CIs are Wilson score intervals.

```{r table4}
international_table(ssd, INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$ssd)
international_table(bd, INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$bd)
```

## Table S4: international case definitions (children under 14, South Sudan)

```{r tableS4}
international_table(ssd_children, INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$ssd)
```
